title: [GMCP 203.024.02] Production path: Unified policy engine and least-privilege authorization
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-024-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: One deny-by-default policy engine mediates discovery, invocation, callbacks, data flow and installation using principal, server, capability, arguments, resource, destination, time, risk and provenance. Delegation uses attenuated capability grants, policy decisions explain their exact rule and version, TOCTOU is prevented by execution-time re-check, and exhaustive architecture tests prove no production bypass. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
